title: Separation of Duties in Approval
summary: Nobody approves a change they proposed or an object they own.
body_markdown:
# Separation of Duties in Approval

## Rule

A decider in a governance record is neither the record's `proposed_by` nor the object's `owner` (or a member of the owner role).

## Rationale

Four-eyes principle; prevents self-approval.

## Scope

All governance records.

## Enforcement

Automated: E096. Machine definition: AR-003.

## Exceptions

None.
